confounding_traps.note: seat_count feeds mrr_usd directly (+3.5/seat), not via the complexity score.
Large companies also skew toward higher plan tiers (direct via tier_price->mrr).

A proxy/mediator trap, not a pure non-causal assignment artifact like ST01/ST02/ST04: acquisition_channel has zero direct effect of its own, but it does causally shift discount_pct, which then genuinely reduces margin.
High-mrr accounts skew toward ACH (enterprise-style invoicing), a direct pathway.
S05 is a genuine interaction; the main effect is a trap. Driven by seat_count<=3 (the opposite tail from ST01's seat_count>=30 — no overlap), independent of ST03's discount_pct pathway.
